programs.title: Stand By Me
programs.desc: Bittersweet film about a gang of four 12-year-old boys growing up in Oregon in the 1950s. The story is told in flashback years afterwards by one of the boys - now a writer - and revolves around their search through the countryside around their hometown for the body of a missing teenager, thought to have been killed by a train. Adapted from `The Body', a novella by Stephen King.

programs.title: The Secrets Of Pecan Summer
programs.desc: We reveal the true story behind the first Indigenous Opera. Composed by Deborah Cheetham, Pecan Summer is her discovery of what really happened to her family in 1939 and why she never knew the truth.
